name: flashdata-google-search
title: Google and YouTube Search Results
description: Browse ranked Google results, compare products and places, find YouTube videos, and copy timestamped transcripts directly in Raycast.
author: flashdatadev

commands.name: search-google
commands.title: Search Google
commands.subtitle: FlashData
commands.description: Search Google by country and language, preview snippets, and copy a link or the full result list.

commands.name: google-images
commands.title: Search Google Images
commands.description: Preview thumbnails and copy the image URL or open its source page.

commands.name: google-news
commands.title: Search Google News
commands.description: Find headlines by topic and read the publisher, date, and snippet before opening a story.

commands.name: google-shopping
commands.title: Search Google Shopping
commands.description: Compare listed prices and merchants for a product and open the offer.

commands.name: google-videos
commands.title: Search Google Videos
commands.description: Find video pages across the web and compare channels, sources, and durations.

commands.name: google-places
commands.title: Find Places on Google
commands.description: Search for local businesses and compare addresses, categories, and available ratings.

commands.name: youtube-search
commands.title: Search YouTube Videos
commands.description: Find up to 20 video results by keyword and open a match on YouTube.

commands.name: youtube-search-extended
commands.title: Search YouTube Videos in Bulk
commands.description: Request up to 700 matches for a keyword and copy the returned set as JSON. Extended search has a separate rate.

commands.name: youtube-metadata
commands.title: Inspect YouTube Video Details
commands.description: Look up a video by URL or ID to read its description, channel, and available chapters.

commands.name: youtube-transcript
commands.title: Get YouTube Transcript
commands.description: Read and copy an existing automatic transcript, with timestamps for individual segments.

commands.name: youtube-captions
commands.title: Get YouTube Uploader Captions
commands.description: Choose a language and copy the existing uploader-provided subtitle track or individual lines.

commands.name: youtube-trainability
commands.title: Check YouTube License Label
commands.description: Inspect the reported Creative Commons label on a video. A label is not permission to train or reuse media.

commands.name: youtube-channel
commands.title: Browse YouTube Channel
commands.description: Enter a channel handle to see its profile and recent uploads in one list.

commands.name: youtube-suggestions
commands.title: Find YouTube Search Suggestions
commands.description: Enter a search prefix and copy YouTube autocomplete phrases for a language and region.

commands.name: youtube-download
commands.title: Deliver YouTube Media to Cloud Storage
commands.description: Send a video or audio track to your cloud storage, then check the job and copy its delivery receipt.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: FlashData API Key
preferences.description: Your FlashData key must allow the commands you use. Submitted requests use your account Credits.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('Use npm run publish for the Raycast Store; do not publish this extension to npm.')"
